# pvecli config

Manage pvecli configuration.

| Command | What it does |
|:--|:--|
| [`add`](add.md) | Add a new profile. |
| [`remove`](remove.md) | Remove a profile or all profiles. |
| [`edit`](edit.md) | Interactively edit a profile. |
| [`default`](default.md) | Set the default profile. |
| [`list`](list.md) | List all profiles. |
| [`info`](info.md) | Show profile details. |
| [`test`](test.md) | Test connection to Proxmox. |
| [`login`](login.md) | Open Proxmox web interface login page in browser. |
